queries.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS lakehouse.demo.shipping_lines_evolution

CREATE TABLE lakehouse.demo.shipping_lines_evolution
WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT * FROM lakehouse.silver.shipping_order_lines ORDER BY orderkey, shipdate LIMIT 100
DESCRIBE lakehouse.demo.shipping_lines_evolution
SELECT file_path, file_size_in_bytes, file_format FROM lakehouse.demo."shipping_lines_evolution$files" WHERE content = 0 ORDER BY file_path
SELECT count(*), to_hex(checksum(ROW(orderkey, shipdate, line_revenue))) FROM lakehouse.demo.shipping_lines_evolution
ALTER TABLE lakehouse.demo.shipping_lines_evolution ADD COLUMN analyst_note varchar
ALTER TABLE lakehouse.demo.shipping_lines_evolution RENAME COLUMN analyst_note TO quality_note
DESCRIBE lakehouse.demo.shipping_lines_evolution
SELECT count(*), to_hex(checksum(ROW(orderkey, shipdate, line_revenue))) FROM lakehouse.demo.shipping_lines_evolution
SELECT file_path, file_size_in_bytes, file_format FROM lakehouse.demo."shipping_lines_evolution$files" WHERE content = 0 ORDER BY file_path

SELECT count(*) AS rows, count(quality_note) AS nonnull_notes
FROM lakehouse.demo.shipping_lines_evolution
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS lakehouse.demo.snapshot_example

CREATE TABLE lakehouse.demo.snapshot_example
WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT * FROM lakehouse.gold.shipping_priority

SELECT snapshot_id FROM lakehouse.demo."snapshot_example$snapshots"
ORDER BY committed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM lakehouse.demo.snapshot_example ORDER BY orderkey

DELETE FROM lakehouse.demo.snapshot_example WHERE orderkey =
 (SELECT min(orderkey) FROM lakehouse.gold.shipping_priority)
SELECT * FROM lakehouse.demo.snapshot_example ORDER BY orderkey

SELECT snapshot_id FROM lakehouse.demo."snapshot_example$snapshots"
ORDER BY committed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM lakehouse.demo.snapshot_example FOR VERSION AS OF 8958695487673263738
ALTER TABLE lakehouse.demo.snapshot_example EXECUTE rollback_to_snapshot(8958695487673263738)
SELECT * FROM lakehouse.demo.snapshot_example ORDER BY revenue DESC
SELECT * FROM lakehouse.demo."snapshot_example$history" ORDER BY made_current_at
